newsitem.title: USA: Biocircuits submits test for FDA approval.
newsitem.headline: Biocircuits submits test for FDA approval.

text.p: Biocircuits Corp said it has filed an application with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for marketing approval of its Quantitative hCG test, which helps track the progress of early pregnancies.
Quantitative hCG is designed to be used with Biocircuits' immunodiagnostic system to allow testing in doctors' offices and other patient clinics.
Of the nearly 4.3 million Quantitative hCG assays ordered annually in the United States, nearly 3.6 million must be sent to outside facilities for analysis of results.

Biocircuits said it is is targeting the approximately 41,000 small to medium-sized physician office practices and free-standing alternate site laboratories which are licensed for high or moderate complexity testing. Most of these sites do not currently have an immunodiagnostic testing capability, it said.
